# spaghetti



```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

coordx_lwr1 <- -121.858
coordx_upr1 <- -121.84
coordy_lwr1 <- 37.315
coordy_upr1 <- 37.35


pems_edges <- pems_repl$edges



pems_edges_proj <- st_transform(pems_edges, 32610)  # UTM zone for this region

# 1. Define your box as an sf polygon


box_poly <- st_polygon(list(
  matrix(
    c(
      coordx_lwr1, coordy_lwr1,
      coordx_lwr1, coordy_upr1,
      coordx_upr1, coordy_upr1,
      coordx_upr1, coordy_lwr1,
      coordx_lwr1, coordy_lwr1
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
)) %>% st_sfc(crs = st_crs(pems_edges))

# 2. Clip the lines by the box
pems_clipped <- st_intersection(pems_edges, box_poly)

remove_ids <- c(1,7,8,14,18,22,23,34,35,36,42,43,47,50,51)

pems_clipped <- pems_clipped %>%
  dplyr::slice(-remove_ids)


graph <- metric_graph$new(edges = pems_clipped, longlat = TRUE)
graph$prune_vertices()



```




```{r}
h <- 0.005
graph$build_mesh(h=h)


edge_length = graph$get_edge_lengths() %>% as.vector()

PtE <- graph$mesh$VtE %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename(edge_number = V1, distance_on_edge = V2) 


xy_vertex <- graph$V
xy_mesh <- graph$mesh$V %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename(x = X, y = Y)

fun1 = function(x) 100*exp(-((x/0.2)^2))/4
fun2 = function(x) 100*exp(-((x/0.16)^2))/3
fun3 = function(x) 100*exp(-((x/0.4)^2))/2

fun <- PtE %>%
mutate(
    f = NA_real_,  # start with NA
    f = ifelse(edge_number %in% c(1,2,3,4,5,8,9,11,12,13,16,20,21,22,23,25), 0, f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 10, fun1((distance_on_edge-0.41)*edge_length[10]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 7, fun1((distance_on_edge-0.6)*edge_length[7]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 14, fun2((distance_on_edge-0.5)*edge_length[14]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 15, fun2((distance_on_edge-0.55)*edge_length[15]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 18, fun3((distance_on_edge-0.5)*edge_length[18]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 17, fun3(distance_on_edge*edge_length[17]+0.5*edge_length[18]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 6, fun3(distance_on_edge*edge_length[6]-edge_length[6]-0.5*edge_length[18]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 24, fun3(distance_on_edge*edge_length[24]+0.5*edge_length[18]), f),
    f = ifelse(edge_number == 19, fun3(distance_on_edge*edge_length[19]-edge_length[19]-0.5*edge_length[18]), f)
  )



x_range <- range(xy_vertex[,1])
y_range <- range(xy_vertex[,2])
z_range <- c(0, max(fun$f, na.rm = TRUE))


FUN_AUX <- fun
FUN_AUX$f_color <- (FUN_AUX$f / z_range[2])^0.3




all_data <- cbind(xy_mesh, fun)

on_vertex <- all_data %>%
  slice((1:22))
all_data_no_vertex <- all_data %>%
  slice(-(1:22))


# Split by edge_number
edge_groups <- split(all_data_no_vertex, all_data_no_vertex$edge_number)


# Function to create a single edge block
create_edge_block <- function(edge_index) {
  start_v <- graph$E[edge_index, 1]
  end_v   <- graph$E[edge_index, 2]
  
  # Get edge data (assuming edge_index corresponds to the same index in edge_groups)
  edge_data <- edge_groups[[edge_index]]
  
  # Create NA row matching the number of columns
  na_row <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(on_vertex)))
  colnames(na_row) <- colnames(on_vertex)
  
  # Combine: start vertex, edge, end vertex, NA
  rbind(on_vertex[start_v, ],
        edge_data,
        on_vertex[end_v, ],
        na_row)
}

# Apply for all edges and combine
final_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(graph$E)), create_edge_block))





final_data$f_color <- (final_data$f / z_range[2])^0.3

on_vertex$f_color <- (on_vertex$f / z_range[2])^0.3




 
x_RR <- range(xy_mesh[,1])
y_RR <- range(xy_mesh[,2])

x_left <- x_RR[1]
x_right <- x_RR[2]
y_bottom <- y_RR[1]
y_top <- y_RR[2]



# 1. Define your box as an sf polygon
x_ini <- -121.853 
y_ini <- 37.3374

x_fin <- -121.851 
y_fin <- 37.340

dx_ref <- x_right - x_left   # 0.018
dy_ref <- y_top - y_bottom   # 0.035

dx <- x_fin - x_ini  # 0.002

dy <- dx * (dy_ref / dx_ref)

y_fin <- y_ini + dy + 0.0006

upper_color <- "darkred" 

style_vector <- c(c(feature = "road", element = "geometry", visibility = "on"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "poi", element = "labels", visibility = "off"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "road", element = "labels", visibility = "off"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "administrative", element = "labels", visibility = "off"), #name of places
                  c("&style=", feature = "transit", element = "labels", visibility = "off"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "landscape", element = "geometry", visibility = "on"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "water", element = "geometry", visibility = "on")) 
register_stadiamaps(Sys.getenv("GGMAP_STADIAMAPS_API_KEY"))
# Obtain the maps
p12 <- ggmap(get_stadiamap(bbox = c(left = x_left, bottom = y_bottom, right = x_right, top = y_top),
              zoom = 16,
              maptype = "stamen_toner_lite", 
              scale =2,
              style = style_vector,
              color = "color")) 

p_spaguetti <- p12 +
  geom_path(
    data = final_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = f_color),
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 1
  ) + 
  geom_point(
    data = on_vertex,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = f_color),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name = "Height",   # legend title
    breaks =NULL,
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 0.5,   # thin bar
      barheight = 6     # tall bar
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(   
    text = element_text(family = "Palatino", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    #panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)   # remove outer whitespace
  ) +
  annotate("segment", x = x_ini, y = y_ini, xend = x_fin, yend = y_ini, 
           linewidth = 1, color = upper_color) +  # Bottom line
  annotate("segment", x = x_ini, y = y_fin, xend = x_fin, yend = y_fin, 
           linewidth = 1, color = upper_color) +  # Top line
  annotate("segment", x = x_ini, y = y_ini, xend = x_ini, yend = y_fin, 
           linewidth = 1, color = upper_color) +  # Left line
  annotate("segment", x = x_fin, y = y_ini, xend = x_fin, yend = y_fin, 
           linewidth = 1, color = upper_color) 
  # xlim(x_left, -121.8475) + 
  # ylim(37.335, 37.345)

x_width <- x_right - x_left
y_height <- y_top - y_bottom
aspect_ratio <- y_height / x_width

mywidth <- 5
myheight <- mywidth * aspect_ratio


# Save temporarily
ggsave(here::here("data_files/map_with_square.png"), plot = p_spaguetti, width = mywidth, height = myheight, dpi = 300)


# x_range <- c(x_left, -121.8475)
# y_range <- c(37.335, 37.345)


rv <- 0.18

xxx <- 10 
yyy <- xxx * aspect_ratio
colaxnn <- "black"
p_spaguetti3d <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(data = final_data, 
            x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~f, 
            type = "scatter3d", 
            mode = "lines",
            line = list(
              color = ~f_color,   # <-- nonlinear boost toward high values               
              colorscale = "Viridis",     # choose any colorscale you like
              cmin = 0,
              cmax = 1,
              width = 6),
            showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  add_trace(data = on_vertex, 
            x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~f, 
            type = "scatter3d", 
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(
              color = ~f_color,   # <-- nonlinear boost toward high values               
              colorscale = "Viridis",     # choose any colorscale you like
              cmin = 0,
              cmax = 1,
              size = 4),
            showlegend = FALSE) %>%
    add_trace(x = rep(final_data$x, each = 3), 
            y = rep(final_data$y, each = 3), 
            z = unlist(lapply(final_data$f, function(zj) c(0, zj, NA))),
            type = "scatter3d", 
            mode = "lines",
            line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
            showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  config(mathjax = 'cdn') %>%
layout(font = list(family = "Palatino"),
            margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 0),
            scene = list(
              xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Longitude", font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16),  range = x_range),
              yaxis = list(title = list(text = "Latitude", font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16), range = y_range),
              zaxis = list(title = list(text = "", font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16), range = c(0,z_range[2])),
    aspectratio = list(x = xxx, y = yyy, z = 1),
    camera = list(eye = list(y = -37.34*rv, x = 0*rv, z = 70*rv),
                            center = list(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0))
  )
)
```

# small

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(lwgeom)





pems_edges <- pems_repl$edges

pems_edges_proj <- st_transform(pems_edges, 32610)  # UTM zone for this region



box_poly <- st_polygon(list(
  matrix(
    c(
      x_ini, y_ini,
      x_ini, y_fin,
      x_fin, y_fin,
      x_fin, y_ini,
      x_ini, y_ini
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
)) %>% st_sfc(crs = st_crs(pems_edges))

# 2. Clip the lines by the box
pems_clipped <- st_intersection(pems_clipped, box_poly)



segments_sfc <- st_sfc(
  do.call(c, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pems_clipped)), function(i) {
    coords <- st_coordinates(pems_clipped[i, ])
    
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(coords) - 1), function(j) {
      st_linestring(rbind(coords[j, 1:2], coords[j + 1, 1:2]))
    })
  })),
  crs = st_crs(pems_clipped)
)

graph <- metric_graph$new(edges = segments_sfc, longlat = TRUE)

style_vector <- c(c(feature = "road", element = "geometry", visibility = "on"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "poi", element = "labels", visibility = "off"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "road", element = "labels", visibility = "off"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "administrative", element = "labels", visibility = "off"), #name of places
                  c("&style=", feature = "transit", element = "labels", visibility = "off"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "landscape", element = "geometry", visibility = "on"),
                  c("&style=", feature = "water", element = "geometry", visibility = "on")) 
register_stadiamaps(Sys.getenv("GGMAP_STADIAMAPS_API_KEY"))
# Obtain the maps

psmall <- ggmap(get_stadiamap(bbox = c(left = x_ini, bottom = y_ini, right = x_fin, top = y_fin),
                zoom = 18,
              maptype = "stamen_toner_lite", 
              scale =2,
              style = style_vector,
              color = "color"))  + xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)




ppaux <- graph$plot(vertex_size = 0, 
                    p = psmall,
                    edge_width = 0) +
  geom_path(
    data = final_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = f_color),
    linewidth = 3,
    alpha = 1
  ) 

p_to_show_geodesic_dist <- graph$plot(vertex_size = 1, 
                    vertex_color = "darkred",
                    edge_color = "black",
                    p = ppaux,
                    edge_width = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name = "Height",   # legend title
    breaks =NULL,
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 0.5,   # thin bar
      barheight = 6     # tall bar
    )) +
    theme_minimal() + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Palatino", size = 14), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
        ) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  annotate("segment", x = x_ini, y = y_ini, xend = x_fin, yend = y_ini, 
           linewidth = 4, color = upper_color) +  # Bottom line
  annotate("segment", x = x_ini, y = y_fin, xend = x_fin, yend = y_fin, 
           linewidth = 4, color = upper_color) +  # Top line
  annotate("segment", x = x_ini, y = y_ini, xend = x_ini, yend = y_fin, 
           linewidth = 4, color = upper_color) +  # Left line
  annotate("segment", x = x_fin, y = y_ini, xend = x_fin, yend = y_fin, 
           linewidth = 4, color = upper_color) 



ggsave(here::here("data_files/p_to_show_geodesic_dist.png"), plot = p_to_show_geodesic_dist, width = mywidth, height = myheight, dpi = 300)
```
